description.zh: 过滤条件，JSON对象字符串，示例：{"field":"Name", "pattern":"configmap-"}。
description.en: The filter conditions. Set this parameter to a JSON string in the format of {"field":"Name", "pattern":"configmap-"}.
The namespace of the Kubernetes cluster.
The number of the page to return. Pages start from Page 0.

description.zh: 分页查询，每页显示的条数。值为0时不进行分页，返回所有内容。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. The value 0 indicates that all entries are returned on one page.

description.zh: 返回使用该保密配置的应用列表。
description.en: Specifies whether to return a list of applications that use a Secret.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas list-k8s-secrets --cluster-id 7a953f9a-2946-4c7a-9d82-9939db000000 --namespace default --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-no 0 --page-size 10 --condition field_:_Name_,_pattern_:_product --show-related-apps true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun edas GET /pop/v5/k8s/acs/k8s_secret --region cn-hangzhou --Condition 'field_:_Name_,_pattern_:_product' --PageSize 10 --ClusterId '7a953f9a-2946-4c7a-9d82-9939db000000' --ShowRelatedApps true --PageNo 0 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace default --header "Content-Type=application/json"
